per_loop_shift.expectation_user: at the published radii, few pairs that depend on an internal loop will be certified, because the set allows the entire norm on one entry; the descriptive label fractions are read against this, not as a performance number
per_loop_shift.what_this_does_not_imply_user: This does not mean most pairs certify. The certificate also credits competitor structures for every touched loop they contain, so exposure depends on the competitors, not on s*. The expectation in PRED comes from the TR0 pilot.

dimension_arithmetic.note: directions that vanish on TR0's entries live entirely on entries only TS0 uses, and are coverage rather than Type B once TS0 is held out; the new ones are what TS0's references had been pinning

components_contained.what_this_checks: a consistency check, not evidence: |B4 B4^T d| <= u_e holds by Cauchy-Schwarz and the definition of delta, so this can fail only through code drift. A component's INF entries (Langdon 2018 forbids some loops) are set to a zero shift before projecting, as for the radii, so 'contains' means contains that INF-zeroed projection; the count above says how many reached entries that concerns.

published_envelope.definition: {theta0 + B t : ||t|| <= r_max, |(B t)_e| <= delta for every e}; per-entry bound u_e = min(delta, r_max * ||a_e||); weights w_L = sum_e |c_{L,e}| u_e, ceiled to dcal as for the ball

il_keys_vs_positional_oracle.oracle: fold_compound.eval_int_loop(i, j, k, l) (vrna_eval_int_loop) on the plain pinned compound: positions only

il_keys_vs_viennarna.how_the_arguments_were_built: E_IntLoop(n1 = k-i-1, n2 = j-l-1, type = PT[S[i]][S[j]], type_2 = PT[S[l]][S[k]], si1 = S[i+1], sj1 = S[j-1], sp1 = S[k-1], sq1 = S[l+1], P = fc.params), S the BCODE encoding with S[0] = S[n+1] = 0 and PT certfold's pair-type table, built from turner_nullspace.PTYPE -- the table il_keys uses. Shares that convention with il_keys; the independent oracle is the positional one.
il_keys_vs_viennarna.oracle: RNA.E_IntLoop on the pinned compound's own parameters

nonzero_offsets_by_radius_explained.line: The first G1 (e1d7d7c) recorded 9,633 / 17,356 / 17,370 nonzero offsets at r = 1.000 / 21.263 / 96.529 on the basis that still carried 2,933 noise rows (norms <= 2.3e-13); each was charged a full dcal once r*w*100 cleared the ceiling's 1e-12 guard, which more of them do as r grows. Rebuilt from the same B_TR0, that projection gives 9,688 / 17,369 / 17,370, of which 7,680 / 15,361 / 15,362 are nonzero only through noise rows, leaving 2,008 at every radius -- what this G1 records. On the current basis ceil(w) at r = 1 over the 923 reached entries is 36 to 91 dcal (median 71), 0 entries have a row norm below 0.01, and 0 / 0 / 0 sampled structures have offset zero by exact cancellation at those three radii.
nonzero_offsets_by_radius_explained.reproduction_note: rebuilt minus recorded: {'r1': 55, 'Andronescu2007': 13, 'r_cap': 0}. Exact at r_cap, where every noise row clears the guard whatever its rounding; below it, which ~1e-14 rows clear a 1e-12 guard depends on rounding a fresh SVD need not reproduce bit for bit

envelope.test: the box bound N(s) - sum_e |dc_e| u_e, an UPPER bound on the envelope's worst case (the envelope lies in the box); certified must imply box-robust, and slack is measured against this bound, not against the exact worst case

pair_tables_vs_enumeration.note: X' from the forbidden-pair fold and Z' from the Zuker set are compared against the enumerated minimum of E' on every sequence and every radius here; a mismatch raises. This is G3's n <= 20 half, done where the enumeration already exists.

G3.n_at_most_20_half: in G2's shard: X' and Z' against the enumerated minimum of E'

recursion_side.what: every fold here, mfe and every subopt_zuker structure: the recursion's energy == eval_structure on the same constrained compound == E0 + the checker's offset; any violation stops the run. The same check runs on every fold of G2, G6, the pilot and the run, and each records its own counts.

sets.ball: radii in kcal/mol, the exact witness test
sets.envelope: lambda = 1, witnesses by the box bound (an upper bound on its worst case), as in G2

G4.the_gap_this_cannot_close: the band comes from the callback, so an under-charging callback would shrink it and pass vacuously; G1's constructed cases and G2's independent enumeration are what close that

G3_recursion_side_on_the_pilot.what: every soft-constrained fold the pilot made: the recursion's energy == eval_structure on the same compound == E0 + the checker's offset
